{{Top|leg}}
'''One Flight''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogues]], typically consisting of [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] through [[Rogue Four/Legends|Rogue Four]]. The flight was normally led personally by the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]].

A flight group designated One Flight was also used by [[Wraith Squadron]], led by [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|Wraith Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].
